page_content.heading: A gym transformed into a space for making.

body.text: The Jewelry Shop project converts a former gymnasium in Wellesley into a refined design studio and retail space. The adaptive reuse preserves the generous volume of the original space while introducing new material layers that create an intimate, craft-focused environment.
The project is currently under administration.
